description: This file contains functions for collecting secret reference assignments from plugin configurations, specifically for the 'acpx' plugin, within a larger application. It handles plugin config normalization, enable state resolution, and secret input collection for MCP server environment variables.

methods.name: collectPluginConfigAssignments
methods.description: Main function to walk plugin config entries and collect secret reference assignments for MCP server environment variables, scoped to the 'acpx' plugin.

methods.name: collectMcpServerEnvAssignments
methods.description: Helper function to process MCP server configurations and collect secret input assignments for each environment variable.
